settings.heading: Su bienestar, nuestro compromiso
settings.text: Nuestra colección propia está diseñada con materiales de alta calidad, estética cuidada y funcionalidad real. Productos para mejorar la vida de perros y gatos… y la tuya. Porque un Aristopeter quiere siempre lo mejor.

notes: Two-column image-with-text section: text content column (560px) + image placeholder column side by side, gap 80px. Eyebrow overline has a leading 24px decorative line (::before). Two buttons: primary (solid foreground-heading bg, background-color text) and secondary (transparent bg, foreground-heading border + text). Buttons have radius 0 (square corners). Uses library Button atom instances (Style Primary/Secondary x State Default/Hover; node 21:10). Only the Desktop variant node was inspected (data-name 'Section / Image with Text / Desktop'); a mobile counterpart likely exists but was not in this node. Single color scheme — no variable resolved to multiple hex values.
